## Our story

<!-- TODO: make this section personal. Why did you start the community? What moment made you decide? -->

{{< var org.name >}} ({{< var org.name-sw >}}) was founded in 2026 to bring together people across Tanzania who use R, the free and open-source language for statistics, data analysis and visualisation.

R is already used in Tanzanian universities, research institutes, hospitals, government offices and NGOs. Yet many users learn on their own, with few chances to meet peers, find a mentor or see how others solve the same problems. We started this community to change that.

## Mission

To build a welcoming, inclusive community where people in Tanzania learn R, share knowledge and use data to address local challenges.

## Vision

A Tanzania where anyone, in any region and at any level, can find the skills, mentors and peers they need to turn data into insight.

## What we value

Everyone is welcome
: Beginners and experts, students and professionals, from every region and background.

Learning by doing
: Practical, hands-on sessions built around real problems and real data.

Open knowledge
: We share slides, code and recordings openly so that anyone can learn from them.

Local relevance
: We focus on the data and questions that matter in Tanzania.

Respect
: Everyone in our spaces follows our [Code of Conduct](code-of-conduct.qmd).

## Part of a global community

R users around the world organise local groups, and we're proud to join them. If you'd like to see what's happening beyond Tanzania, have a look at [AfricaR](https://africa-r.org/), [R-Ladies](https://rladies.org/) and the [R Consortium](https://www.r-consortium.org/), which supports R user groups worldwide.

## Partners and supporters

We're grateful to the organisations that help us with venues, funding and expertise. Interested in supporting the community? [Here's how](join.qmd#partner).
